'''Derren Flet''' was an [[Architect/Legends|architect]] who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]].

==Biography==
Flet worked as Jabba's chief architect.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5 (Second Edition)">[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi'', Second Edition]]</ref> The [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had him commission the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']] and his fleet of [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] from the [[Ubrikkian Custom Vehicle Division|Ubrikkian Corporation]].<ref name="SWCL" /> Flet also designed additions to his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], focusing on the dungeons.<ref name="SWCL" /> Flet provided Jabba with almost everything he wanted, making the palace function as both a stately manor and fortress; however, he failed to provide adequate space for Jabba's prisoners, leaving the existing dungeons intact. This made Jabba so furious that he had Flet [[Death/Legends|killed]] immediately.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5 (Second Edition)" /><ref name="OSVC 6">[[Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection 6|''Star Wars: The Official Starships & Vehicles Collection'' 6]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Architect.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Derren Flet's possible appearance.]]
[[Jabba's architect]] from [[Star Wars: Outlander|''Star Wars: Republic: Outlander'']] may be the same character as Derren Flet. An explicit connection between them has not yet been established in canon, although both are considered famous<ref name="Galaxy Guide 5 (Second Edition)" /><ref name="Star Wars: Republic 8: Outlander, Part 2">[[Star Wars (1998) 8|''Star Wars'' (1998) 8]]</ref> and Jabba has only been referenced as having a single architect.<ref name="OSVC 6" />
